title: Draft academic working paper and begin controlled evaluator comparisons
description: Write rigorous academic-style paper with completed evidence, problem formalisation, related work and prospective experiment protocol; compare bounded evaluator approaches on existing frozen grid audio with new seed/wording, resumable logs and engineering checks. Audit alternate model prerequisites without large blind downloads. No invented listener labels or claims of reward validity.
close_reason: Wrote and successfully compiled academic working paper with nine cited references, formal problem/methods, measured pilot and follow-on results, limitations and prospective human/model protocol. Completed six-method fixed-pool comparison: five new seed renders, 12 new features, 46 cache hits, pause/resume/zero-budget replay; alternative models audited but not inferred. 52 Python tests (2 optional skips), 53 JS checks, comparison playback and required audio/evolution browser regressions pass. Published local listening page; model follow-up awen-3fr.6.2.2 recorded. Reader defaults unchanged.

title: Pilot CLAP-guided evolution from the nine-direction grid
description: Bounded real native audio/CLAP search on current grid for Rat safe-drop passage. Frozen independent descriptions, retained baseline, paraphrase/seed/window checks and silence/loudness controls. Resume unique jobs/cache/logs; present reproducible listening comparison without promoting runtime defaults or claiming validated reward.
close_reason: Completed real bounded CLAP grid evolution: 21 search candidates, 3 fresh-seed renders, 56 new features/4 shared cache hits. Mean gain persists on fresh seed and unused wording but reversals/silence/specificity controls block reliable-reward claims. Listening page and downloadable candidate prepared; source defaults unchanged. Real pause/resume and completed zero-budget replay plus 50 Python/53 JS tests and comparison Playwright pass. Documented and archived proof.

title: Differentiate instrument articulation and kinetic scene accompaniment
description: Respond to listener feedback: action passage feels too placid and palette timbres too similar. Improve native synthesis envelopes, excitation and spectral evolution; offer contrasting kinetic directions without resetting continuity or raising limiter. Validate native instrument attack/sustain signatures and action versus calm, preserve old exploration backups as separate versioned artifacts.
close_reason: Implemented composer v3 with stable familiar theme streams, plucked-string excitation, sustained breath/vibrato winds, bowed/brass articulations, kinetic pursuit/pizzicato grid options and rhythmic action response. Native eight-instrument pitch/envelope/bounds proof plus explorer, production audio, evolution and western Playwright suites pass; 53 JS / 47 Python tests (2 optional skips). Earlier explorer/paired assets retained; documented limits.

title: Add nine-direction soundtrack exploration to the review workflow
description: Give the review tool a 3x3 starting grid with nine audibly contrasting recipe/palette/harmony directions, sparse likes/shortlist and another bounded exploration round. Render previews on demand through the production engine without a large pre-rendered dataset. Keep one preview active, output cap, unique exports/history and local persistence. Preserve existing paired calibration labels and keep exploration feedback separate from blinded fit data. Test playback, evolution, storage/export and responsive grid in isolated Playwright; document and present a working local preview.
close_reason: Implemented standalone nine-direction explorer with production on-demand audio, three retained parents, seeded bounded refinement, backups and reader-profile downloads. Validated nine native 32-second renders, playback cancellation, persistence/import, mobile/dark UI and production audio/evolution regressions; 47 Python tests (2 optional skips) and 52 JS checks pass. Guide: research/nine-direction-exploration.md. Existing paired labels preserved.

title: Build a blinded resumable listening-calibration packet and label workflow
description: Prepare six developer-selected scenes with three native-rendered alternatives each, balanced same-scene playback and a separate blinded offline review page. Record fit, enjoyment and distraction separately with ties/uncertainty and listening provenance. Keep private recipe/control keys separate, deterministic pair randomisation and identity/swapped controls, unique logs and resumable render jobs. Validate/export/import labels without inventing ratings, deduplicate revisions and summarize coverage/control consistency. Reserve existing War holdout, keep runtime unchanged and document the small pilot's limitations.
close_reason: Implemented and prepared the real blinded packet plus offline review, resumable native preparation/reuse, unique logs, revisioned human-label import and control/coverage summaries. Added bounded Windows atomic-write retry after a real sharing failure. 46 Python tests, 52 JS tests and isolated Playwright review checks pass; public preview verified without private-key exposure. Engineering proof and TODO/docs updated. No human ratings, ranker training or calibrated reward claimed.

title: Calibrate the development audio judge against listener choices before expanding score search
description: Use score-lab's real WAV packets with an audio-capable pinned judge; record actual provider/version and separate fit, coherence and estimated intrusiveness. Check identical/no-audio controls, swapped orders, audio replacement and prompt rewording. Compare against a few human judgements of personal taste, fit and reading comfort; hold out books/chapters/seeds. Keep cost bounded, examine gaming/loudness biases and require held-out improvement before adopting any preset. Never add an LLM to browser/device runtime.
notes:
Prepared the six-scene blinded pilot in awen-3fr.6.3: Rat/Riders/Time, three native alternatives each, 18 optional comparisons, independent fit/enjoyment/distraction fields, explicit listening provenance, local progress and JSON backup/restore. Raw imports are immutable and checksum-checked; latest revisions deduplicate votes, conflicts are excluded, and identical/reversed controls are summarized without training on them. War is excluded; Time is now calibration material. All 18 native clips passed engineering gates, final packet reused compatible audio with no new synthesis, and real labels remain zero. Next gate is actual listener feedback/control review and exact-listened-audio feature extraction before any ranker or reward promotion.

27 October bounded grid CLAP evolution completed in awen-0qr: 21 search candidates + 3 fresh-seed renders. Higher mean cosine survives fresh seed/unused wording on average, but caption/window reversals, silence outranking music for a check caption and no action-specificity gain mean raw CLAP is still not a reliable reward. Evidence/selected genome: research/grid-clap-proof.json and research/grid-clap-evolution.md. Listen to original/grid-best/evolved clips before any adoption; no human ratings or runtime defaults changed.

title: Prototype a development-only score search and audio-judge evaluation loop
description: Build a small seeded candidate search using the production native renderer, objective signal/continuity/variation gates, fixed train and held-out book fixtures, blinded audio-judge packets and a bounded optional development adapter. Keep narrative fit, musical coherence and likely intrusion separate; do not claim reading comfort or taste from a model. LLMs may guide development only: no runtime model dependency or automatic promotion. Prove failure controls and archive a tiny run before larger processing.
acceptance_criteria: Small native rendered batch; reproducible candidates/manifests; silence/monotony/discontinuity controls rejected; strict actual-audio judge contract and order-bias checks; no judged quality claims without actual responses; documented held-out/calibration gates; unchanged single-file runtime.
close_reason: Implemented development-only bounded seeded search, native audio render/archive, objective gates, strict blinded audio-judge exchange, swapped-order and identical/missing-audio controls, optional adapter loop and held-out reporting. Eight native clips passed engineering gates; no LLM called or musical winner claimed. 51 unit tests plus isolated Playwright audio/evolution pass. Runtime HTML unchanged. Judge calibration remains awen-3fr.6; chapter-aware runtime policy remains awen-7x1.3.2.

title: Fix dropdown contrast in night mode
description: Make select controls and their options readable in night mode, including the harmonic-direction gallery, and verify dark-mode contrast with isolated Playwright.
close_reason: Themed opaque select/option surfaces and borders verified in dark/light modes, keyboard selection and mobile layout by isolated Playwright. Dark text contrast 13.17:1 and border contrast 4.74:1.

title: Balance gallery preview levels with bounded on-demand measurements
description: Implement an optional approximate RMS preview-level comparison using one short offline measurement per played candidate, attenuate only before the shared final limiter, retain direct unbalanced comparison, and verify signal spread, cancellation, caching and output bounds. This is a small fairness proof, not perceived-loudness equivalence or full archived replay.
close_reason: Implemented optional attenuate-only RMS balancing, lazy 16-second measurement/cache, original-level comparison and cancellation-safe playback. Native six-candidate check reduced RMS spread 1.63x to 1.03x; final limiter remains on every audible path. 30 unit tests and both Playwright suites passed.

title: EVO-05 — Fair and reproducible comparisons
description:
Source: TODO.md / EVO-05 — Fair and reproducible comparisons

- [ ] Keep passage, seed, musical starting state, narrative target and non-evolved settings consistent across candidates.
- [ ] Compare similar phrase-length excerpts; test whether sequential playback or switching at a shared musical position is easier to judge.
- [ ] Check loudness bias between variants. The output cap bounds samples but does not establish equal perceived loudness.
- [ ] Record full generation lineage: parents, all candidates, selected/rejected/skipped items, mutation settings, versions and preview context. Current history stores A/B decisions and only the latest 80.
- [ ] Add reliable replay of an archived comparison, with clear handling of incompatible composer/content/genome versions. Symbolic replay does not promise identical DSP samples across browsers.
notes:
Completed child awen-3fr.5.1: on-demand approximate RMS balancing attenuates only, with cache/cancellation checks and unchanged output cap. In a small six-candidate native render, raw highest/lowest RMS 1.63 became 1.03 at reference volume. This does not establish equal perceived loudness. Gallery context is fixed and accepted choices retain selected-preview gain metadata. Remaining: listening evaluation of loudness/switching, full generation-lineage/archive decisions and compatible archived replay. No large corpus or pre-rendered library added.
awen-88h adds optional development score-lab with matched seed/timing, version/hash archives, attenuation-only WAV comparisons, order-swapped judge requests and failure controls. This is separate from UI saved-comparison replay; original remaining work stays open.

title: EVO-04 — Taste, narrative fit and reading comfort
description:
Source: TODO.md / EVO-04 — Taste, narrative fit and reading comfort

- [ ] Distinguish I enjoy this, It fits this passage and It helps me read. Do not treat them as the same judgement.
- [ ] Add optional quick feedback: too busy, too plonky, too droney, too tense. Keep these separate from candidate selection.
- [ ] Transfer general taste across books; investigate scene-specific preferences without memorising unrelated tunes per paragraph.
- [ ] Let feedback be sparse and voluntary; avoid prompting after every paragraph.
- [ ] Evaluate optional lightweight local preference ranking only after collecting useful choices. Human selection and bounded mutation remain sufficient for the first version.

title: EVO-03 — Richer musical traits
description:
Source: TODO.md / EVO-03 — Richer musical traits

- [ ] Evaluate traits for melodic rest frequency/length, motif spacing, harmonic change rate, register, orchestration and scene persistence.
- [ ] Improve foreground/background interaction so more continuous music can still breathe without returning to an unchanging drone.
- [ ] Define perceptually useful bounds and test extremes/combinations. Preserve coherent harmony, scheduling, polyphony and output limiting.
- [ ] Audit the current six traits for audible range and interactions, including whether activity increases/decreases are equally useful.

Acceptance: different genomes produce clearly different musical behaviours, while every candidate remains a plausible reading accompaniment.
notes: 27 October listener iteration: procedural pluck/wind/bow/brass articulation and pursuit/pizzicato recipes implemented in awen-ejv. Engineering probes verify distinct decay/pitch and matched-energy signal differences; perceptual realism, useful trait bounds and long-session preference remain unvalidated. See research/instrument-articulation.md. Next use actual listening across passages to choose richer traits; do not infer taste or narrative-fit labels from waveform differences.

title: EVO-02 — Explore nearby or explore widely
description:
Source: TODO.md / EVO-02 — Explore nearby or explore widely

- [ ] Add a mutation-strength control: small refinements versus broader exploration.
- [ ] Start each batch with the unchanged parent, a few nearby variants and at least one more distant but musically constrained option.
- [ ] Prevent duplicate/nearly identical candidates; vary audible characteristics rather than only changing seed labels.
- [ ] Define compatible recombination for multiple selected parents. Preserve authored harmonic/phrase constraints and output limits.
- [ ] Separate a composition seed from a personal preference genome and a palette identifier. Record all three.
- [ ] Keep the existing foreground/background scope; consider locking any trait the listener already likes.

Acceptance: repeated selection can refine a favourite, while broad exploration can escape an unhelpful starting point.
notes: Nearby/wide controls, scoped multi-parent recombination, unchanged parent plus pins, minimum parameter-distance checks, and a further-afield candidate are implemented as part of the gallery proof. New candidates always alter melody or background presence to avoid only subtle filter/room changes. Composition seed, palette and genome remain separate and are recorded with adopted choices.
close_reason: Implemented nearby/wide scoped multi-parent evolution, distinct bounded candidates, preserved parent/pins and a further-afield option. Validated 28 unit tests and native six-candidate Playwright audio/UI proof. Perceptual quality remains a human listening gate.

title: EVO-01 — A gallery with a wider choice
description:
Source: TODO.md / EVO-01 — A gallery with a wider choice

- [ ] Replace or supplement the two-option comparison with an initial gallery of **six candidates**, including the current favourite. Six is a starting design choice to test, not a research result.
- [ ] Use clearly labelled cards with Play/Stop, Keep favourite, Pin and Explore from here. Play only one candidate at a time through the existing limited output graph.
- [ ] Offer a few optional plain descriptions such as warmer, more space or more movement. Generate descriptions from actual parameter differences; do not imply the system heard or understood the music.
- [ ] Allow one favourite or several selected parents; offer None of these and New batch without forcing a ranking of every candidate.
- [ ] Preserve pinned favourites between rounds. Let the listener replay the parent and undo a generation.
- [ ] Keep previewing optional and separate from ordinary reading. Restore the reading position and original score cursor when leaving the gallery.
- [ ] Test keyboard access, touch layout, accessible playing/selected states and the time burden of listening to six options.

Acceptance: a listener can hear a meaningfully wider range, choose one or more promising directions and generate a new round without losing favourites or their reading place.
notes: Implemented six-card accessible dialog with 16-second previews, one persistent limited audio graph, pin/unpin (three saved favourites), multi-parent exploration, skip/new batch, eight-batch undo, restore/cancel, and bounded profile migration. Automated tests cover keyboard, mobile, persistence and native signal variation. Listening usefulness and the 96-second upper bound for six full previews still need a short human trial; no dataset or cloud processing added.
close_reason: Implemented and validated gallery proof; 28 unit tests and real Playwright gallery checks pass. Human listening quality remains an explicitly separate evaluation task.

title: Set up Beads and migrate the Awen exploration backlog
description: Initialise the local embedded database, migrate TODO.md into prioritised epics/tasks, document the workflow, and verify persistence and dependency readiness. Do not publish or commit existing application changes.
close_reason: Initialised embedded Beads, migrated all open roadmap strands, added dependencies and repo workflow documentation; unit tests passed.

title: Run one pinned alternate music evaluator sanity comparison
description: Follow experiment ledger and paper E1. Audit exact checkpoint/component access, licences, preprocessing, dimensions and expected compute. Prefer a small matched-file probe before new data or large search. Compare a music-specific embedding or preference head against pinned CLAP on existing clips and silence/shuffle/wording controls. Do not feed cached general-CLAP vectors into a head trained on different encoder. Keep model claims separate from human fit/taste/comfort agreement; no provider or listener results invented.

title: Implement and run a tiny resumable CLAP association probe
description: Add optional local Python CLAP backend with pinned music checkpoint/revision/preprocessing, independently written scene briefs, matched/shuffled/unsuitable/silence controls and feature cache keyed by exact audio/text/model/preprocessing. Reuse existing native rendered clips. Preserve unique logs and resumable jobs; report diagnostics separately from musical quality, fit and reading comfort. Run a small real-model proof before any expanded search or training; leave cross-model/held-out calibration open.
close_reason: Implemented optional CLAP backend with pinned revision/weight checksum/preprocessing, source/manifest checks, shared content-addressed vector cache, unique logs and resumable jobs. Completed real 14-feature controlled probe plus cache-reuse proofs. Found/rejected collapsed music checkpoint, measured working replacement and documented weak scene alignment rather than promoting any candidate. 32 Python and 52 JS tests pass; runtime/native renderer unchanged. Broader comparison remains parent awen-3fr.6.2.

title: Pilot aligned scripts, cue sheets and score audio before any model training
description: Inspect a few radio-play music cues and silent-film cue sheets with exact associated recordings/editions. Scripts often specify source music or transitions, not the full background score. Build a tiny provenance/permissioned alignment manifest with scene text, music function, cue entry/exit, timings, instrumentation, dialogue/effects contamination and uncertainty. Old orchestral recordings without narrative alignment cannot by themselves teach scene scoring. Keep film/recording/composition rights distinct, split by whole work/composer where possible, and include no-music cases. Test retrieval/transfer with existing embeddings before considering fine-tuning or large processing. References: research/audio-text-evaluation.md.

title: Evaluate pretrained audio-text embeddings as score-development diagnostics
description: Compare LAION CLAP (including music-trained checkpoints), MuQ-MuLan and CLaMP 3 on a tiny fixed Awen audio/scene-brief set before training or downloading large datasets. Keep embedding association separate from narrative function, musical quality and reading comfort. Use aligned windows, positive/negative briefs, swapped audio and held-out books/genres; pin model/revision/preprocessing/licence and cache features by audio/text hashes. Keep embeddings separate from the LLM judge contract and use any calibrated model only during development unless a small local runtime option is later justified. Sources and limitations: research/audio-text-evaluation.md.
notes:
Completed first CLAP slice in awen-3fr.6.2.1. Optional pinned local CPU backend, exact window/text feature caching and resumable journal now measured. Initial laion/larger_clap_music text tower collapsed (independent API check corroborated by public MTEB issue); added rejection guard and used pinned larger_clap_general. Four real windows: intended over shuffled 2/4, unsuitable descriptions rejected 4/4, wording reversals 2/4 and silence beat intended pairings 2/4. Not a calibrated evolution reward. Fourteen-feature pause/resume and separate cache-only experiment verified. Remaining: MuQ-MuLan/CLaMP comparisons, broader held-out and human calibration. See research/clap-probe.md and proof JSON.
27 October documentation update: explicit calibration roadmap in research/clap-probe.md and TODO.md. Next deliverable is a replayable blinded packet/label format with about six scenes and a small pilot of pairwise fit/taste/distraction judgements. These pilot counts are proposals, not a reliability claim. Freeze encoder initially; compare raw cosine, predeclared paraphrase ensemble and a regularised feature ranker against incumbent/simple baselines. Add silence/drone/attack/noise/loudness/transition attacks, held-out whole-work/seed checks and scene-grouped uncertainty. Use shortlisting first; no automatic reward promotion until listener agreement and controls support it. CLAP may be omitted if unhelpful. No new experiment or calibrated reward in this docs update.
27 October academic paper and fixed-pool objective comparison added in awen-2yo. Six methods, same CLAP encoder; five new seed clips, 12 new features/46 cache hits. Prior evolved winner no longer exceeds incumbent on new-description mean; this is post-hoc sensitivity evidence, not cross-model validation. TuneJury/MuQ/CLaMP preflight and next gate in research/experiment-ledger.md. Primary TuneJury documents gated MERT plus separate music encoder; same-dimensional general CLAP vectors are incompatible.

title: Implement resumable Python orchestration for development audio evaluation
description: Use Python where it improves integration with existing ML, audio-analysis and LLM libraries. Start with a small bridge around score-lab's versioned JSON/WAV manifests and native browser renderer; avoid maintaining a second synthesiser. Compare reproducibility, provider integration and dependency/cost burden before expanding. Preserve seeds, audio hashes, gates, judge controls, held-out splits and lineage. Any accepted result must compile to small local rules, parameters, recipes or an appropriate tiny model; finished browser/device playback has no LLM/Python/server requirement.
notes: Implemented stdlib Python job orchestration over the native renderer/shared metrics with trusted Python audio-provider adapter interface. Unique experiment/invocation/attempt artifacts, fsynced atomic checkpoints, kernel writer lock, hashed per-job cache, durable raw responses, stable provider idempotency keys, request limits, explicit uncertain retries/reconciliation and source/renderer/model identity checks. Real four-clip smoke paused after one clip, resumed three remaining, then cache-only resumed; three unique invocation logs and zero provider calls. 18 Python lifecycle/protocol tests include actual os._exit deaths; 52 JS tests pass. Model/embedding calibration remains under parent and awen-3fr.6.2; aligned-reference pilot awen-7x1.2.2.
close_reason: Python/native bridge implemented and validated with real resumed renders plus process-death/failure tests. Shared proposal key-order compatibility fixed; docs, measured proof and TODO updated. Finished HTML remains unchanged and model-free.

title: Update roadmap for offline score search, evaluation and Python integration
description: Bring TODO.md up to date with completed score-lab work and open metric/judge calibration, bounded search, chapter continuity, replay, richer traits and listener gates. Record Python as an optional development orchestration layer while retaining production native audio and a self-contained non-LLM runtime. Link current Beads issues and remove stale next-step claims.
close_reason: Updated TODO.md with completed score-lab foundation, full open evaluation/search/continuity/lineage/listener checklist, development-only LLM constraint and Python bridge option. Added linked awen-3fr.6.1 and refreshed stale shipped-feature/next-step entries; local links and diff formatting checked. Documentation only.

title: Make chapter boundaries explicit in automatic score-direction policy
description: Use chapter context to distinguish smooth paragraph-level expression from larger automatic changes in preset, tonal regime, seed or motif identity. Preserve continuous playback and gradual layer/activity changes inside a chapter; larger changes may enter at a suitable musical boundary after chapter change, not on every paragraph. Keep explicit user controls/restart/seek separate. Add varied traversal/longer fixtures to score-lab and native UI checks before changing the runtime director. LLM only in development; runtime policy remains deterministic and local.

Add a complete Standard Ebooks western with attribution, stable paragraph navigation and offline embedding. Preserve existing preferences, classic playback and the final output limiter; verify new palettes, shelf and night-mode controls with Playwright.
